name: qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-dflash2-tp2
description: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 over both Sparks (TP2) with the z-lab DFlash2 drafter, 8 tokens a step, on the stock vLLM 0.31.0 image. NVIDIA's validated two-Spark recipe: no patches, no custom image.

source.title: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 — TP2 + DFlash2 on stock vLLM 0.31 (NVIDIA)
source.author: NVIDIA local-ai-inference-recipes (recipe and measurement), z-lab (drafter)

measured.note: NVIDIA's measurement of 2026-10-14 on two DGX Sparks: SPEED-Bench coding prompts, one request at a time, 8,192 output tokens each, image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0. Not measured with TwinSpark yet; no figures for several requests at once.

requirements: Image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0 (arm64) on both nodes — Pin resolves its digest. No patches, no mods.
Weights nvidia/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 and the drafter z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 on both nodes: staged on the first activation. Pin pins both commits and loads the drafter at its pinned commit.
notes: A port of NVIDIA's two-Spark recipe with the same image, vLLM flags and environment. TwinSpark sets the node wiring (interfaces, RoCE devices, ranks) from controller.yaml, as for every recipe.

gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 is NVIDIA's value for two Sparks. For the same model on ONE Spark NVIDIA uses 0.6 on its NGC image: 0.85 hung the node during the start-up autotune and 0.70 took nodes down on some runs. Watch MemAvailable on both Sparks during the first start.
The text-only mode adds --language-model-only, as NVIDIA's notes suggest: the vision encoder is not loaded, which shortens the start and frees its memory. Image inputs are then refused.
eugr's recipe for the same model (recipes/qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-dflash2.yaml) runs on a locally built vllm-node image with instanttensor loading. It is listed under Cookbook → Community.

vision.title: Text and images — as NVIDIA ran it
vision.description: The recipe as published: text and image inputs.

text-only.title: Text only
text-only.description: Without the vision encoder (--language-model-only): a shorter start and its memory free for the KV cache. Image inputs are refused. Not measured separately.
